population.note: the 25 K1 specs contain byte-identical duplicates and variants that return bit-identical results; the family is the unit

repeats_policy: repeat only a CP-SAT solve that did not prove optimality; greedy is deterministic
inner_means: AOT co-design with ModelBlaster: graph rewrites and the per-dispatch implementation choice, decided offline against isolated per-dispatch profiles
outer_means: HIL: measured multipliers from real-time runs of the whole schedule, returned and re-solved against
scoring: instance-level misses on BOARD costs for every cell; A/B are solved on predicted costs then re-cost with the assignment fixed, C/D are solved with --board-calibration
